item.title: NWMAC Traveling Art Exhibit will be in Warren until February 3
item.description: The Northwest Minnesota Arts Council (NWMAC) sponsors an annual Traveling Art Exhibit, which visits northwest Minnesota communities throughout the year. item.description: The Minnesota Department of Natural Resources will conduct aerial elk surveys in the next few weeks when snow cover and other conditions allow. item.title: City of Crookston to collect real Christmas trees
item.description: The City of Crookston Public Works department will be conducting Christmas Tree pickup from January 5-16. Please place your tree on the berm to have your tree collected. If you have any questions, please reach out to Public Works at (218) 281-1232.
